description: This file defines the 'Theme' entity class for the ORM mapping, representing themes in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for theme attributes such as images and variables, along with related getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Entity class representing a theme configuration for OrangeHRM, with image and variable properties, including related constants and ORM mappings.
